candidates.function: Examine a nominated prepared surface and, only if feasible, place one real root through the existing paid trial operation.
Physically examine one reachable x/y footprint and report visible surface evidence plus provisional compatibility with the existing root-placement operation.

execution.progress: A disposable action cursor may end; the exact paid job and escrow persist. Two completed work rounds are required. Resume restores remaining work; cancellation/death settles once.

details.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
details.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Offset is a zero-based record offset; part selects a large exact-record fragment. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience.
